name: bola-detector
description: BOLA Detector, by Variablee: paste a public repo URL, see its routes traced and scored for BOLA / IDOR.

MONGODB_URI.description: Mongo connection string, ideally naming a database (mongodb+srv://user:pass@host/route_tracer)

ALLOWED_GIT_HOSTS.description: Hosts users may clone from, comma-separated, or * for any

ANALYZE.description: 0 to skip the LLM analysis and show the trace only

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: LLM key for the analysis (or set OPEN_AI_API_KEY instead). Without a key, scans show the trace only.

POSTMARK_API_TOKEN.description: Postmark server token for the action emails. Without it, no emails are sent.

POSTMARK_FROM.description: Sender address: a confirmed sender signature or domain in Postmark (defaults to NOTIFY_EMAIL)

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth web client ID. With the secret set, every page needs a Google sign-in.

ALLOWED_DOMAINS.description: Only these email domains may sign in, comma-separated (empty: any Google account)

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Only these Google accounts may sign in, comma-separated (empty: any)

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Accounts that see every user's scans, comma-separated
